title: matricaria segetum
intro: Matricaria segetum, commonly known as Cornflower or False Chamomile, is a flowering plant in the daisy family, native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It is valued for its calming and soothing properties, offering health benefits such as reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting a good night's sleep. The therapeutic actions of Matricaria segetum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and anti-spasmodic effects, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
